scope.boundary: external-world sensing, opportunity evidence, bounded capture, research triangulation, evidence return, and plan-only feedback
excluded: live scraping performed by this documentation task
scope.case_architecture_separation: ARICA/Fondart is one real pilot and supervision signal; it is not the reusable architecture.

authorities.name: MAK physical state
authorities.rule: Physical files and observed processes are authoritative; Git is transport only.

authorities.name: Versioned external documentary evidence
authorities.rule: An opportunity claim requires a captured source, content hash, version, locator, and temporal-validity state.

authorities.name: Artist archive evidence
authorities.rule: Practice, artifacts, relations, and authorship are supported only by archive-scoped evidence; opportunity documents cannot prove them.

authorities.name: Verified external outcome
authorities.rule: Receipts and externally observed outcomes may inform routing and ranking, never factual truth or artistic identity by themselves.

consumers.name: Shared opportunity review queue
consumers.accepts: ranked discovery candidates, not verified eligibility

consumers.name: Research capability
consumers.accepts: non-dispatched bounded jobs with source policy and value-of-information metadata

consumers.name: Shared product plan
consumers.accepts: evidence-governed possibility and fit state for portfolio, application, and research products

consumers.name: Bounded autonomy planner
consumers.accepts: validated product, research, evidence-return, and optional shadow-learning state

consumers.name: Human supervision
consumers.accepts: abstentions, contradictions, gaps, proposals, and external-action boundaries

states.meaning: A listing was detected and deduplicated; truth, currency, and eligibility remain unverified.
A local source snapshot exists but current official validity is not confirmed.
Current official validity is explicitly confirmed by provenance-bearing evidence.
Temporal validity is stale, unknown, or incomplete; downstream fit must abstain.
The source gate fails; downstream fit cannot pass.
A research job is specified but no network or external action has been authorized or executed.
Triangulation found support from the required independent source groups; promotion remains none.
Counterevidence is preserved and prevents silent closure.
Returned evidence is additive and awaits explicit ingestion and deterministic recomputation.
The system preserves an actionable uncertainty instead of manufacturing a positive or negative fact.

components.role: Detect change in watched sources, deduplicate listings, isolate per-source failures, rank candidates, and enqueue review candidates.
limits: listing hash is not a documentary snapshot hash

components.role: Separate capture planning from one-URL recording and preserve whether a network call occurred.
limits: backend availability is not source truth

components.role: Compile a local, versioned documentary package into deterministic operational constraints without fetching, database writes, or fit claims.
limits: local observation is not current verification

components.role: Join external requirements to internal practice evidence only through explicit requirement IDs and compute conservative fit state.
limits: external PDF evidence never proves practice fit

components.role: Project explicit gaps and source-validity uncertainty into deterministic non-dispatched research jobs.
limits: generated questions are restricted to explicit source-validity refresh

components.role: Reconcile frontier job-requirement pairs with provenance-bearing result batches and test source-group and domain independence.
limits: two URLs from one source group are not independent

components.role: Transform supported or contradicted research results into additive proposals, notices, and deterministic fit-recompute requests.
limits: practice proposals require existing artifact refs
fit changes only after explicit ingestion and recomputation

components.role: Select bounded plan-only observe, research, recompute, compile, wait, or abstain actions with explicit stop conditions.
limits: dispatch, publication, submission, promotion, training, and database writes are disabled

evidence.observation: Per-source exceptions are isolated; 304 is not failure; stable listing hashes suppress duplicates; ranking explicitly avoids eligibility or truth claims.
The default decision is plan; record=true performs one bounded capture and emits network_called plus a receipt.
Source SHA-256, locators, explicit validity, contradictions, unknowns, and deterministic reconciliation are enforced by the compiler.
Source validity is a control gate; missing required evidence or incomplete scored criteria remains abstention rather than positive fit.
Research jobs preserve requirement ownership, source policy, independent-group count, VOI, and planned_not_dispatched status.
Captured sources require URLs, raw and text hashes, license state, and independent explicit source group plus URL domain; unmatched pairs are errors.
Only supported candidates with at least two groups and evidence refs can become pending opportunity proposals; contradictions and unresolved rows remain explicit.
Every action is plan-only, bounded to one attempt, includes preconditions and success/failure observations, and keeps all consequential controls false.

The accepted Piso 1-5 chain passed 173 focused tests in its recorded checkpoint; the real ARICA/Fondart pilot remained research-first because source validity was observed_local and unconfirmed. This task did not rerun that gate.

gaps.evidence_needed: A current official-source capture tied to the Fondart source-validity requirement and triangulated receipt.
A bounded current backend run with receipt, hashes, license state, exit code, and no secret exposure.
A tested adapter from listing candidate to capture plan and versioned documentary package without bypassing license or validity gates.
blocked_claims: all watched opportunities automatically enter the canonical opportunity compiler

gaps.evidence_needed: Per-source refresh intervals and expiry semantics measured against official change behavior, deadlines, and capture cost.
blocked_claims: refresh timing is adequate for every opportunity family

gaps.evidence_needed: Projection of existing C04-C06 technical witnesses into practice evidence with artifact refs and without web-evidence or authorship promotion.
blocked_claims: ARICA dossier has supported curatorial claim atoms

gaps.evidence_needed: Verified outcomes across independent artist/archive identity groups before any policy promotion.
blocked_claims: MAK has learned a reusable opportunity-selection policy
